name: Tvarjuk
source:
Take on the role of Alexey, who is hiding from pursuit in a place full of ghosts from the past. The village, familiar to him from childhood, comes alive in his memory: terrifying grandmother's tales, carefree childhood days, and... an encounter with a nightmare lurking in the dark forest.🌳

Will you dare to step into the fairy tale if it turns out to be real? 💀

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2992240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演阿列克谢（Alexey）的角色，他躲在一个充满过去鬼魂的地方躲避追捕。那个从小就熟悉的村庄在他的记忆中栩栩如生：可怕的祖母的故事，无忧无虑的童年时光，还有……与潜伏在黑暗森林中的噩梦的遭遇。🌳

如果童话成真，你敢走进吗？💀

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2992240/]Steam[/url]]
